description: Pylones de Troyes Champagne Métropole is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Troyes Champagne Métropole. Definition: Support in metal frame or concrete, of an overhead power line. Selection: All towers or gantries constructed to support a power line of at least 63 kV are included. Coverage: Troyes Champagne Métropole. The portal shows the English title as "Pylons of Troyes Champagne Metropolis" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Troyes Champagne Métropole. Its keywords include pylones, troyes-champagne-metropole. The listing shows 4 download or service links in CSV, GPKG, XLSX, PDF. The listing shows 2024-08-08 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
